summary: Regencell Bioscience Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K on May 19, 2026, disclosing a registered direct offering of 985,222 ordinary shares at $20.30 per share, expected gross proceeds of ~$20 million. The offering is led by a new fundamental institutional investor ($19M) with participation from Univest Securities as sole placement agent. The shares are offered under an existing effective shelf registration statement on Form F-3. Closing is expected on or about May 20, 2026, subject to customary conditions. This is a routine capital raise via a shelf takedown, not a special situation. What to watch: any pricing discount and dilution impact.
